name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 91 – Am 37
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 91. Recalls that, as required by the Financial Regulation, programmes and activities should, where feasible and appropriate and in accordance with the relevant sector-specific rules, be implemented to achieve their set objectives while respecting working and employment conditions under applicable national law, Union law, the conventions of the International Labour Organization, and collective agreements, including occupational health and safety requirements, taking into account the principle of gender equality and without doing significant harm to the environmental objectives of the Union; stresses that access to Union funds should be conditional on compliance with applicable labour and occupational health and safety law and that serious or repeated breaches should give rise to proportionate corrective measures, including suspension, recovery or exclusion, where appropriate;
